dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A prominent interconnected double-annulus structure resembling a vertical '8' is located in the upper-mid dorsal region, characterized by thin, high-intensity perimeters with a sharp gradient to darker interiors. A distinct singular 'O' shaped ring with a well-defined circular perimeter is located on the mid-flank, posterior to the central axis.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A large, high-density cluster of saturated white pixels forms an amorphous, high-intensity region on the lower-mid flank. This area lacks an internal gradient and shows a core concentration of high-intensity values. Secondary lower-density clusters of high-intensity pixels are visible towards the anterior neck region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the dorsal '8' structure, the mid-flank 'O' ring, and the center of the large lower-flank high-intensity blob form an obtuse scalene triangle. A series of smaller annuli to the posterior of the central 'O' ring form a roughly linear chain of keypoints.

other_distinctive_markers: The vertical figure-eight interconnected annulus in the upper-mid dorsal region represents a highly unique topological marker.
